name: The Rundown Tools

sources.title: Submit your AI tool - The Rundown AI

requirements: AI tools for the 'Supertools' directory, curated by The Rundown AI team
Free route is email-only: 'Email support@therundown.ai with your tool's name, URL, category, and a one-sentence description'
A paid route exists separately: newsletter feature via /advertise-with-us
preparation: Tool name, URL, category, and a one-sentence description - exactly the four things the page asks for
Send from an email address you monitor; the team reviews recommendations manually
workflow: Click the mailto link (subject pre-filled 'Tool Submission') or email support@therundown.ai directly
Include tool name, URL, category, and one-sentence description
Wait for the team's review; no on-page form is used
watchFor: This is an editorial recommendation, not a self-serve listing - acceptance is entirely discretionary
Do not confuse 'Recommend a Tool' (free) with 'Newsletter Feature' (paid advertising)
The audience is 2M+ newsletter readers; the bar for inclusion is presumably high
No stated review time or confirmation process
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the Rundown/Supertools tools section at rundown.ai/tools (or its app subdomain) with a public entry.
unknowns: Review turnaround and whether rejections are communicated
Whether the tools link is dofollow
Whether paid newsletter features also produce a permanent directory listing
